content_sections.heading: About Graphic Era University Research Associate
content_sections.text: Graphic Era (Deemed to be) University, Dehradun is conducting recruitment for a temporary Research Associate position within its department. The appointment is aimed at candidates with specialized research backgrounds in food technology, food processing, and related engineering disciplines. The selection process includes an online interview scheduled for 17 November 2026. The position is purely temporary for 2 years and does not confer any claim for regular appointment at the University.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification covers a single position for Research Associate. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification criteria prescribed by the University to be eligible for consideration.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in Food Technology/Food Processing/Food Engineering or a relevant discipline.
rows.preferred_experience: Candidates having research experience during Ph.D./Postdoctoral research in plant proteins, protein characterization, food processing, extrusion technology, meat analogues, or related areas will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a monthly emolument of ₹58,000/- per month along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per Institute norms. The position is purely temporary for 2 years and does not confer any claim for regular appointment at the University.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxations
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST/Women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates will be applicable as per norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Graphic Era University Research Associate
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may send their detailed CV mentioning educational qualifications, research experience, publications, and contact details to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be assessed through an online interview. The interview is scheduled to be held online on 17 November 2026.
